title: Lovely Crops FIX
body:
I really like the idea of the [Lovely Crops](https://modrinth.com/mod/lovelycrops) mod, but I couldn't make items from it, so I added recipes for corn soup and grape juice via a datapack.

- I simplified the crafting recipes: now grape juice requires 3 grapes instead of 6, and corn soup needs 3 corn.
- You can now craft from grape/corn seeds to replant even more!
